mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sys_menu.* FROM sys_account LEFT JOIN sys_account_role ON sys_account.id = sys_account_role.account_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu ON sys_account_role.role_id = sys_role_menu.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu ON sys_role_menu.menu_id = sys_menu.id WHERE sys_account.user_name = #{userName} ORDER BY order_no ASC) sysmenu WHERE id IS NOT NULL

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sys_menu.perms FROM sys_account LEFT JOIN sys_account_role ON sys_account.id = sys_account_role.account_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu ON sys_account_role.role_id = sys_role_menu.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu ON sys_role_menu.menu_id = sys_menu.id WHERE sys_account.id = #{userId}) sysmenu WHERE perms IS NOT NULL AND perms != ''
